title: AppointmentTopicTimeSlot - Data API
description: Represents a lookup to a work type or a work type group for a time slot This object is available in API version 52.0 and later.

AppointmentTopicTimeSlotKey.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
AppointmentTopicTimeSlotKey.description: Non-editable validating field used to ensure no two rows have the same time slot and work type or work type group values in an instance.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: Name or ID of the AppointmentTopicTimeSlot object.

OperatingHoursId.description: The operating hours that contain the time slot. This is a relationship field.

TimeSlotId.description: The ID of the time slot. This is a relationship field.

WorkTypeGroupId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
WorkTypeGroupId.description: The work type group associated with this time slot. This is a relationship field.

WorkTypeId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
WorkTypeId.description: The work type associated with this time slot. This is a relationship field.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **AppointmentTopicTimeSlotChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **AppointmentTopicTimeSlotFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **AppointmentTopicTimeSlotHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **AppointmentTopicTimeSlotOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **AppointmentTopicTimeSlotShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
